change: Every public/private block now authenticates model, tokenizer and RoPE labels. Private-only requests no longer depend on an absent public-prefix chain for identity binding.
effective_byte_encryption_key: The existing encrypt-then-MAC primitive derives its split encryption/MAC/IV material from key plus AAD; adding identity to AAD also separates the stream across identities.
legacy_records: Prior CPU measurements remain version1; never relabel them as version2 measurements.
legacy_object_policy: Version2 recovery explicitly rejects unversioned/version1 objects.
